## Summary

What changes, and why? Link a related issue if there is one.

## Verification

Describe the checks run and their results. For behavioral changes, include a regression test.

## Privacy, protocol, and publication

Describe any changes to stored data, credential handling, publication thresholds, external requests,
or dependencies. Use synthetic examples only. If adding/removing files, review and update
`public-source.json`. Report vulnerabilities privately using `SECURITY.md`.
